items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: Yeah, he played Dewey Jackson, but he was with a big band of Missourians, I think.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played Dewey Jackson, but he was with a big band of Missourians, I think. Oh yeah, Fountain Blue. Fountain Blue. I don't know if that's a Fountain Blue song. They both flew up on the staff. What's the name of the record?
It's called Snake Up Dance. It's on Victor. You still don't recognize the clarinet player? You'll recognize him in a minute.
